grading_basis: Grades are PASS or FAIL only, strict reading of each assertion's text (BUILD.md section 5 grading paragraph and the round v1.3.2 rules given in the brief). A required section missing fails even if its content appears elsewhere. Every file:line the new report cites (location, evidence chain, verification table, refused section, coverage, hand-off) was opened in the fixture at 7a07141 (base working tree, clean at that commit per git status, plus git show <commit>:<path> for the cited regions). The statement reading gives the cited-lines grade (a line of a statement or construct spanning several lines holds the cited code when the statement or construct does); the physical-line reading (the physical line must hold every element the report attributes to it; enclosing function names are context) is recorded for every cited line and gives grade_physical_line for A3. A confirmed finding is an item with the verdict VERIFIED REAL, so Low items with that verdict are confirmed findings and are held to A3 to A9 like the High ones. Hygiene (A7) counts files git would track; ignored build output is recorded only. Manual test runs outside the recorded commands do not by themselves fail anything. For A5, every item that is not VERIFIED REAL needs one of the four dispositions inside the Refused or unconfirmed candidates section; dispositions only in the Hand-off are graded under grade_other_reading; out of zone is allowed only for a defect of another registry zone, and (new in this round) an out-of-zone disposition is invalid when the candidate's file is inside the Context scope or among the files cited in the Verification section, which is a file-level test as worded. Where another ambiguity remained, the stricter reading gave the grade and the other reading is recorded. Validity is taken from outputs/run-meta-transcript.txt and outputs/self-checks.txt. No script of the skill, no test and no recorded command was run; only reads, ls, grep, sed -n, wc, cmp, read-only git and python3 -I -B read-only snippets were used.
